code.note: The last commit that touched the code this file is computed by. Rerunning the builder with that code and the census above writes this file byte for byte.

scope.line: Every Aave V3 pool in the registry and every Morpho Blue market, on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base
scope.inScope: Every Aave V3 pool registered in the PoolAddressesProviderRegistry of mainnet, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base, and the Morpho Blue singleton of each of those chains (recall-coverage/inputs/oct10/onchain/events-scan.json).
scope.outOfScope: Every other chain (Avalanche alone had 531 Aave V3 liquidations in the window), Aave V2, Spark and the other Aave forks.

meta.oracle: Each protocol’s own oracle, read on chain: every Aave V3 market’s AaveOracle and every Morpho Blue market’s oracle, the price in force at each minute start (no look-ahead). The real liquidations are valued at their own block’s oracle prices.
meta.method: Every position liquidated on an Aave V3 pool or a Morpho Blue market of Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Base between 00:00 UTC 10 Oct and 23:59 UTC 11 Oct 2025, all of them walked. The real side is every liquidation of the position in that window, measured on chain: the debt the liquidators repaid, valued at the liquidating block’s own oracle prices. Membrane’s side starts from the same position at the first liquidation the protocol’s own health check confirms (t0), with its whole composition read the block before, and walks it minute by minute on each leg’s own protocol-oracle path: a breach inside line × 1.04 waits eight hours; a return under the line clears the timer; past the band, or still over the line at expiry, the position is repaid to its borrow cap (line − 3pp) with the $2,000 floor, and it walks on. Stablecoin collateral, or a line above 90%, gets no window and is repaid the minute it is over its line†. A position holding both is split the way Membrane would hold it. Both sides are summed over the same positions; the 13 whose loan token has no USD price count in every position total and in no dollar total.
meta.sameSet: Both sides are reported on the same positions: the WALKED ones. The stream reducer folds real records into its totals for walked positions only; a position not walked counts in coverage and nowhere else. USD totals skip a position whose loan token has no USD price, on both sides.

gridEnd.rule: A position still inside its 8-hour window when the data ends (23:59 UTC 11 Oct) has not been sold: the window is still open. The census books it as sold at the last minute’s price, the conservative choice, and every Membrane total here includes that sale. It is marked wherever it appears.

crossCheck.label: Old census (747 rows, superseded)
crossCheck.line: The old census priced 747 Aave accounts and said Membrane closes 36% less (Aave $34.69M, Membrane $22.20M). On the same 747 rows this census gives $34.70M and $13.13M†. The Membrane side moved because the old census priced every account off mainnet Chainlink rounds: each L2 chain’s own oracle moves it $-8.10M, mainnet’s AaveOracle instead of the round log $-2.93M, the full composition instead of the liquidated leg +$0.86M, the line $-0.00M, and the factors together another +$1.10M. Switching all four back reproduces the old $22.20M to within $1,698.

caveats: Membrane has no mainnet deployment. Everything on its side is the contract’s rules run against the day’s real prices†, not a measurement of a live protocol.

73 positions were still inside their 8-hour window when the data ends (23:59 UTC 11 Oct). A window still open is not a completed sale; the census books each as sold at the last price, which is the conservative choice. Those sales are $0.03M of Membrane’s total† and are marked in the table.

13 Morpho positions borrow a token with no USD price on that day (DEGEN, EURCV, USDf, ZCHF, eUSD, sUSDS). They are walked and counted in every position total, and left out of every dollar total and median on both sides.
The real side can repay more than the debt at t0: a borrower can borrow again between liquidations, and interest accrues. Membrane’s walk starts from the t0 position and adds neither.
The repay to cap is sized from the oracle value of the collateral and assumes the sale executes at that price. On an illiquid leg that is an upper bound.
The timer is cleared the minute a position is back under its line. Both clearing paths are permissionless calls somebody has to make; the sensitivity where nobody does is published below.
The cure column is a price-only diagnostic: it ignores the band and re-arming, and no dollar is computed from it.
The result is path-dependent. 10 Oct was a sharp wick with a partial recovery; a market that keeps falling would not cure.
Out of scope: every chain other than Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base, and every lending venue other than Aave V3 and Morpho Blue (Aave V2, Spark and the Aave forks).

all.label: Aave V3 and Morpho Blue, four chains

cure.definition: Price only, the same definition as the old builder (scripts/build-evidence.ts): the position’s LTV at every minute from t0 to t0 + 8h (or the data end), its whole t0 composition with every leg on its own protocol-oracle path, against its own line. Cured = the lowest LTV in that span is at or under the line; minutes = when that lowest LTV is reached; healthy at 8h = the LTV at the last minute is at or under the line. A position with no window (stablecoin collateral, or a line above 90%) is never counted cured. It ignores the band and re-arming: it is a diagnostic, and no dollar is computed from it.

freshPrints.source: AaveOracle (Aave V3 Core, mainnet), price in force at each minute start

noEarlyClear.rule: Nobody calls the permissionless clear: a return under the line does not stop the timer, so a delay that started runs to its expiry or its band break (DelayTimer noEarlyClear).

noDebtFloor.rule: The $2,000 liqDebtMinimum floor is not applied: every sale is the bare repay to cap.

singleSale.rule: At most one sale per position: the walk stops after the first repay to cap (headline: up to 20).

noWalkOnAfterT0BandSale.rule: The headline walks a delayed position sold at t0 past line x (1 + band) on after that sale, like every other sale: a sale leaves no timer (a band break or an expiry deletes it, LiquidationEngine.sol:1724-1727 at 16e12329; an Immediate sale, :1694-1703, never had one) and nothing closes the position. This rebuild stops it after the one t0 repay — the behaviour before 2026-10-14.

t0PriceBasis.rule: t0 is valued at block-N oracle prices, or at block N-1 where N does not show the breach the protocol liquidated. For positions the protocol's own check locates at BOTH bases, this counts those whose t0 decision (per half: under the line / inside the band / past the band / no-delay sale) differs between the two, and rebuilds the census valuing every position at N-1 wherever N-1 locates it.
